verdict.rationale: Crossplane exposes Kubernetes Custom Resources / a declarative API that in principle any Kubernetes client library (kubectl, Go, Python, etc.) can drive, and docs explicitly market it as 'APIs that humans, automation, and AI systems can safely act on.' However, the evidence pack contains no concrete example, SDK, or hands-on verification of an application programmatically creating/managing Crossplane resources — the only probe result focuses on the CLI needing a cluster, not on programmatic API usage.
